subject: science
passage: Hydrologists often describe the Indus as one of the great irrigation systems of the world. The river ______ flows about 3,000 kilometers from the Tibetan Plateau to the Arabian Sea, has supported farming along its floodplain for thousands of years.
stem: Which choice completes the text so that it conforms to the conventions of Standard English?

explanation.why: "Which flows about 3,000 kilometers ..." is a nonessential clause that adds information about the river, so it needs a comma before it and a comma after it. The sentence then reaches its main verb "has supported."
explanation.A: Incorrect. A nonessential clause needs a comma before it. Without the opening comma, the closing comma after "Sea" splits the subject from its verb.
explanation.B: Incorrect. A period turns the clause into a sentence fragment that starts with "Which" and has no independent clause. The text needs one sentence here.
explanation.C: Correct. The clause "which flows about 3,000 kilometers" adds extra detail, so it is set off by a pair of commas. The main sentence then continues with its verb "has supported."
explanation.D: Incorrect. A semicolon joins two independent clauses. "Which flows..." is a dependent clause, so a semicolon cannot introduce it.
